name: J2 no, it is a new one: a new request is submitted

dynamic_variables.open_requests: R-1042: Trucking at Route 104 Widening, 3 trucks tri-axle dump trucks, needed by Monday, November 2 at 7:00 AM, recorded Saturday, October 31 at 6:45 AM

simulation_scenario: You are Dale, a foreman on the Roster. When the assistant asks what you need, say: "I need one water truck at the 104 job Monday at nine." When it asks whether this is about your existing tri-axle dump trucks request, say: "No, it's a new one." When it reads the details back and asks whether to submit, say yes. After it answers, say that's all, goodbye.
success_conditions: Before any read-back or submit, the agent calls find_duplicates with job_id 14 and category Trucking, then asks whether this is about the existing tri-axle dump trucks request from Saturday, October 31 at 6:45 AM, as one question.
After the Foreman says it is a new one, the agent reads back one water truck at Route 104 Widening, Monday, November 2 at 9:00 AM and asks whether to submit it.
After the Foreman says yes, the agent calls submit_requests once with one item for the water truck with job_id 14 and category Trucking, and does not call add_note.
The agent says it is recorded and sent to the office, not confirmed yet, and gives the reference number R-1043.
The agent never says whether trucks or anything else is available, never gives a time when anything will arrive, be done or be decided, and never says the existing request is confirmed.
